series_end_reason: From the Q1 2026 report the brand is no longer a separate line; it sits within a therapy-class line whose footnote names it (long-acting insulin 'Comprises Tresiba, Xultophy, Levemir and Awiqli'). Q1 2026 and Q2 2026 contain no row for the brand.
series_start_reason: Q1 2017 is the first report with Xultophy as its own table line. The 2014-2016 reports print Xultophy only inside the combined 'new-generation insulin' line (footnote: 'comprises Tresiba, Ryzodeg and Xultophy'), in which no Xultophy-only figure was found; the Q4 2016 report records the FDA approval of Xultophy 100/3.6 in November 2016.
moa: Fixed-ratio combination of a basal insulin analogue (insulin degludec) and a GLP-1 receptor agonist (liraglutide)
notes: Worldwide net sales in DKK million as printed. Quarters 2017Q2, 2017Q3, 2017Q4, 2018Q2 and 2018Q3 are year-to-date less the preceding year-to-date, because the report prints no quarter-only row for Xultophy until the Q4 2018 report; all other quarters are read directly. Xultophy is printed worldwide only (Total column); the regional columns that follow show US and international splits and are not used to change scope. The European Commission authorisation (September 2014) predates the series; the 2014-2016 sales are inside the combined line and are not separable.
